findings.rationale: The tf_cloudtrail_disabled fixture leaves the main management trail with logging disabled, so account API activity produces no audit record.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_cloudtrail_disabled/input/main.tf at resource aws_cloudtrail.main where trail logging is turned off

findings.rationale: The tf_s3_no_access_logging fixture defines the audit_logs bucket without any server access logging configuration, so object-level access goes unrecorded.
